hana: quick note — during the midnight GPU onboarding window eu-central controller-manager flapped leaders and apiserver returned bursts of 5xx starting ~01:05 UTC.
omar: seeing it on graphs. etcd leader switches ~5x in 15m, commit latency up to 110ms.
lucy: we applied a stricter pod-network policy for the onboarding namespace at 00:57 to isolate experimental workloads.
hana: logs show gRPC EOFs from apiserver to etcd and controller-manager lease errors. excerpt:
```
2026-05-12T01:06:03Z controller-manager: failed to renew lease: rpc error: code = Unavailable desc = transport is closing
2026-05-12T01:06:05Z apiserver: watch stream closed: EOF
```
omar: likely ephemeral port blocking in the policy + NAT churn from node joins. quick rollback of the policy returned stability within ~4m.
lucy: created ticket INFRA-5110 for postmortem and cost calc — extra watch re-lists added ~9k token-equivalents.
hana: action items: 1) doc ephemeral port ranges in onboarding helm chart (lucy) 2) add a preflight e2e that verifies controlplane peer connectivity before applying netpol (omar) 3) consider small bump to etcd election timeout in eu-central as a safety net (discuss in retro).
ops-bot: incident_log: INFRA-5110 created owner=infra-team severity=low at=2026-05-12T01:12:00Z
omar: will PR netpol change and apply during next maintenance window. closing unless anyone sees regressions.
